doc_friction.issue: The only Hearth & Horizon proposal (The Wet Bulb) carries its own note that it overlaps a finished story, so a run has to invent a subject anyway; with 347 done stories, a short keyword index of covered subjects would speed the overlap check more than grepping DONE.md's long lines.
The audio cap (400 MB) has been exceeded for many runs (423 MB today), so every run is text only; the prompt still describes audio as the default deliverable.

deviations.why: Did not take the one open proposal (The Wet Bulb), whose own note says it is too close to The Stone That Keeps the Sun
deviations.did: Wrote an original story on two-ended submarine cable fault location, checked against DONE.md (no prior cable-repair story)
deviations.result: Story landed text only; Done entry and timeline row added

notes: Project: Hearth & Horizon (science fiction shelf). Piece: the-step-that-goes-up (5,470 words incl. note), text only (audio 423 MB > 400 MB cap). Security queue empty; IDEAS.md and website requests empty; routed creative by weighted draw. Verification: node --test in ventures/hearth-and-horizon 15/15 pass; check_post_frontmatter, check_post_links pass; post_similarity 0 pairs >= 0.25. Adversarial re-read fixed 6 slips before commit (grapnel depth vs elapsed time, cable km vs list km, 'two weeks' vs eight days, length rounding, depth claimed before location known, mud source).

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: researching cable fault location and repair practice, working the numbers, drafting and fact-checking a 5,000-word story plus a post

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
